note: First published schema of the nexus run --json document, generated from RunJsonOutput in cli/src/run_contract.ts on release/v1.3.0. The only change to the printed document is the new first member schema_version; every existing member keeps its name, type and meaning.
Clarify verifier input binding in the run-result documentation. Description-only schema change; the JSON shape and meaning are unchanged, so schema_version stays 1.

Add the INFERENCE_SUBMISSION_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED reason and optional continuation fields for objective inference submission counts and history completeness. Additive fields preserve existing meanings, so schema_version stays 1.
Add optional objective elapsed-time usage fields to execution results. The fields are additive and preserve existing meanings, so schema_version stays 1.
Add OPERATION_INFERENCE_SUBMISSION_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED for durable operation-wide request caps. The new stop reason is additive and existing result meanings are unchanged, so schema_version stays 1.

Add OPERATION_TOKEN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED for the durable operation-wide request-token estimate ceiling. The stop reason is additive and existing run-result meanings are unchanged, so schema_version stays 1.

Add optional inferenceOutcomeUnknowns and pendingInferenceSubmission execution fields so interrupted provider requests are explicit in run results. Additive fields preserve existing meanings, so schema_version stays 1.
